# MT5 MatchTrader MVP
This project is a minimal viable product (MVP) for integrating MT5 trading accounts with Match
Trader prop firm accounts. It allows you to manage your trading activities across both platforms seamlessly.
It requires the following accounts:
- MT5 trading account
- MatchTrader prop firm account(s)
